description: Eight original fixtures for receipt extraction, visual inventory, recipe capture, and cooking observations.
evaluation_notes: Give the system under test only the input image and scenario user message. Keep this catalog, source prompts, expected-text.json, HTML, and annotations on the evaluator side.
Photo expectations are conservative visual-review annotations, not physical ground truth. Generation prompts are not evidence of what the final pixels show.
Fridge photos are independent scenes, not before/after photographs of one household. The skillet photo is not evidence that the fixture recipe was followed.
No production ingestion or model benchmark has been run. These fixtures define cases for a future harness.
Dates and prices are fabricated fixture data. No expiry date, purchase-to-fridge link, or remaining amount is implied.

assets.title: Warehouse receipt
assets.description: Six grocery purchases with abbreviations, package sizes, and a yogurt multipack.
must_not: Treat 24 eggs as 24 packages.
Treat 2x32 oz as two purchased multipacks.
Infer expiry dates, storage locations, or current remaining quantities from the purchase record.
assets.suggested_user_message: I bought these groceries. Extract the purchases for review.

assets.title: Same receipt, different capture
assets.description: The same transaction rendered at a different angle, size, and background.
must_not: Add the same groceries again because the image bytes differ.
Use image hash alone as the complete transaction deduplication strategy.
assets.suggested_user_message: Here is another picture of that receipt.

assets.title: Weighted produce, coupon, and return
assets.description: Weighted bananas, multi-quantity food, a coupon, paper towels, and a milk return.
must_not: Add coupons, taxes, totals, or paper towels to food inventory.
Interpret the negative milk line as a new purchase.
Silently subtract a milk package from an unrelated lot when the return cannot be matched.
assets.suggested_user_message: Please review this receipt and suggest food inventory changes.

assets.title: Overstuffed family fridge
assets.description: Crowded shelves, overlapping packages, stacked leftovers, turned labels, and produce behind cloudy drawers.

observed_candidates.label: closed egg carton partly covered by other containers
multiple lidded and wrapped food containers

expected.suggested_followup: Ask for a closer photo of a specific obscured shelf or label when it would resolve a needed item or quantity.

review_notes: Reviewed the generated pixels: shelves are densely stacked, retail panels largely face sideways, and crisper contents are partly obscured. Some foreground items remain identifiable, as they would in a usable real-world photo.
Do not require the prompt's approximate package count. Hidden objects and exact food identities are not ground truth.
Other visually supported candidates, such as mushroom-like pieces, may be offered tentatively. The candidate list is not an exhaustive household inventory.
must_not: Treat the broad view as a complete inventory or remove items that cannot be seen.
Count each visible fragment as a separate package when the fragments may belong to one obscured container.
Infer exact ingredient amounts, remaining milk volume, or the number of eggs inside the carton.
Treat generic packaging, nutrition panels, or container shape as proof of a specific product.
Invent dates, freshness, spoilage, or safety conclusions from an untidy fridge.
Treat possible receipt matches as new purchases or silently replace recorded quantities.
assets.suggested_user_message: Here's a quick photo of my fridge. Help me figure out what's there and what you need me to check.

assets.title: Half-open door, obstructed view
assets.description: Foreground bottles block the view; glare, soft focus, crinkled bags, and crowded shelves hide food and labels.

observed_candidates.label: leafy produce in overlapping clear bags
tall carton with its front hidden

expected.suggested_followup: Ask to open the door fully and photograph the blocked shelf or an unreadable label when needed.

review_notes: Reviewed the generated pixels: door-rack bottles and the door edge block the sides, highlights reflect from bags, and shelf content overlaps heavily.
The generated image remains usable: its main difficulty is occlusion and unreadable product identity, not total blur.
Visible container contents may support broad tentative descriptions; recipe identity and measured amounts remain unknown.
This is an independent scene, not a second angle of fridge-overstuffed-v2.
must_not: Delete stored food based on failure to see it behind the door or other packages.
Assert exact brand, contents, amount, or expiration from an unreadable or turned-away label.
Report exact egg, produce, or package counts when items overlap or are inside closed containers.
Count separate visible patches of one bag as multiple purchases.
Require identification of fully hidden groceries to pass this fixture.
Infer freshness, spoilage, food safety, or household completeness from this single view.
assets.suggested_user_message: Can you update my fridge inventory from this quick photo? Tell me what isn't clear.

assets.title: Complete recipe screenshot
assets.description: Original recipe with eight ingredient lines, four steps, fractions, and optional Parmesan.
must_not: Treat optional Parmesan as a required shopping item.
Assume the household owns ingredients because the recipe lists them.
Invent a published author, source URL, nutrition facts, or dietary certification.
assets.suggested_user_message: Save this recipe and preserve its quantities, steps, and optional ingredients.

assets.title: Recipe cut off mid-list
assets.description: Same recipe, only the first four ingredient lines fully visible; the fifth line is cut off and all methods are absent.
must_not: Recover hidden ingredients or method steps from the evaluator's complete fixture.
Present generated steps as extracted screenshot content.
Treat the screenshot as a complete recipe.
assets.suggested_user_message: Can you save the recipe in this screenshot?

assets.title: Cooking photo with uncertain protein
assets.description: Fusilli, red tomato pieces, wilted greens, and browned pale chunks in a skillet.
must_not: Assert chicken versus a plant-based protein with certainty.
Deduct recipe quantities based only on visual similarity.
Infer allergens, exact oil/butter use, or food safety from the photo.
Assume this meal followed recipe-complete.
assets.suggested_user_message: Here's what I'm making. What can you identify, and what do you need to know to record it?

scenarios.setup: Apply the first receipt after explicit test-user approval, then retry the same request with the same idempotency key.
scenarios.pass: Only one purchase record and one set of six grocery purchase lines exist.

scenarios.setup: Apply the first transaction, then upload the recapture with a new request identifier.
scenarios.pass: Detect the existing transaction; create no additional purchase events. Both evidence images may be retained.

scenarios.setup: The test user says the photo is a later snapshot of their inventory; this is scenario context, not a visual fact.
scenarios.pass: Reconcile possible matches without recording a second purchase. Ask about uncertain quantities; do not infer consumption, returns, or waste from visual discrepancies.

scenarios.setup: Seed inventory with eggs, milk, spinach, strawberries, and chicken.
scenarios.pass: Produce a partial observation, retain unobserved items, and request a targeted retake if needed. Stored chicken remains because a blocked view is not evidence of removal.

scenarios.setup: Fresh session, no access to recipe-complete or the expected data.
scenarios.pass: Save a partial recipe, retain the four readable ingredient lines, and request the remainder. Any proposed recipe completion is explicitly generated.

scenarios.setup: Fresh session without a selected recipe or user-confirmed ingredient quantities.
scenarios.pass: Suggest ingredient candidates, request needed information, and apply zero inventory deductions.

scenarios.setup: Apply the reviewed receipt, persist state, then start a fresh agent session.
scenarios.pass: Recover the same purchase records, provenance, and unresolved quantities without relying on prior chat messages.

scenarios.setup: Use the explicitly confirmed inventory below and target two servings. These quantities are scenario data, not claims from a fridge photograph.
scenarios.pass: List the two known shortfalls, flag oil quantity for checking, and keep Parmesan optional. Do not treat unknown oil quantity as zero or sufficient.
